title: A refused axiom that shares no symbol with the goal does not suppress the refutation
note: "A refutation needs the whole context" is a rule about THIS obligation's context, not about the file. Reading the run-level refused set made one unencodable feature value anywhere in a model downgrade every confirmed counterexample in it to `verification/not-evaluable` and exit 2, while `--engine literal` reported the same row `refuted` and exit 1. `parity` cannot exclude a witness for `bus.mass`, and the relevance closure the engine already computes is what says so.
